// diagnostic

E0515

`{word}` can't leave a deep check

What

`{word}` can't leave a deep check

Why

A deep check runs only where `--deep-checks` keeps it, so whether the function or loop goes on can't depend on it.

Fix

Take the `{word}` out of the `#On(.Deep)` body.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0515: tests/ui/deep_check_break.stderr.

Error [jet.DeepCheckLeavesItsBody]: `break` can't leave a deep check

 Fix: Take the `break` out of the `#On(.Deep)` body.
